test_title: PYST 33: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 10% of the voters did not vote and 150 votes were declared invalid. The winner got 350 votes more than his opponent, thus he got 50% of the total voters registered in the voter list. The percentage of votes of the defeated candidate out of the total registered votes is ________. (count up to one place after the decimal)
solution:
Given:

Percentage of candidates did not votes = 10%

Invalid votes = 150

A got votes more than B = 350

Percentage of A secured the total voters on the voter list = 50%

Calculation:

Let total voters on the voter list = x

A got votes = x × (50/100)

B got votes = x × (50/100) – 350

x × (50/100) + x × (50/100) – 350 = x × (90/100) – 150

⇒ 0.50x + 0.50x – 350 = 0.90x - 150

⇒ x – 350 = 0.90x – 150

⇒ 0.10x = 350 – 150

⇒ 0.10x = 200

⇒ x = 200/0.10

⇒ x = 2000

Votes of the loser candidate = 0.50 × 2000 – 350 = 1000 - 350

⇒ 650

Percentage votes of the loser candidate

⇒ [650/2000] × 100

⇒ 32.5%

**Therefore, the percentage of votes of the defeated candidate out of the total registered votes is 32.5%.**
